title: What Galactic Internet Architecture Is
definition: Galactic Internet Architecture: a network protocol for light-year-scale delays.
description:
Galactic Internet Architecture: a network protocol for light-year-scale delays. This is Interstellar & Deep Space Futures at its most ambitious — delay-tolerant routing research, network logistics engineering and store-and-forward operations converging on a single goal: making network hulls real.

Why it matters: Interstellar & Deep Space Futures will decide time protocols outcomes this century. Galactic Internet Architecture is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working network hulls, the larger delay-tolerant routing vision stalls, and with it, the network logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Galactic Internet Architecture in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Galactic Internet Architecture
title: Real Research Today: Galactic Internet Architecture
definition: Today's documented research behind Galactic Internet Architecture.
description:
The road to Galactic Internet Architecture is already being paved. NASA Innovative Advanced Concepts (NIAC) funds early-stage interstellar propulsion studies, including fusion and beamed-energy concepts. CERN's antimatter research (ALPHA, AEgIS) studies antimatter properties relevant to far-future propulsion physics.

Project Hyperion ran an international design competition for crewed generation-ship concepts. Together these programs form the delay-tolerant routing foundation that Galactic Internet Architecture will build on — the network logistics results, the store-and-forward methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as network logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2032 — First long-duration time protocols testbed runs a sealed network
title: 2032 — First long-duration time protocols testbed runs a sealed network
definition: 2032 milestone on the Galactic Internet Architecture roadmap.
description:
First long-duration time protocols testbed runs a sealed network hulls habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the delay-tolerant routing recycling math.

What must be true first: the delay-tolerant routing results have to replicate outside the lab, network logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and store-and-forward operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed delay-tolerant routing demonstrations, network logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting store-and-forward uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Galactic Internet Architecture
definition: Estimates Galactic Internet Architecture readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Galactic Internet Architecture components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a network hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Galactic Internet Architecture Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Galactic Internet Architecture operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Galactic Internet Architecture installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 1204 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where delay-tolerant routing monitoring, network logistics redundancy, or store-and-forward maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Galactic Internet Architecture Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Galactic Internet Architecture: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Galactic Internet Architecture — a network protocol for light-year-scale delays.

Phase 1 — Prove (delay-tolerant routing): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (store-and-forward): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (time protocols): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and galaxy-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
